recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, film-grain textured composition featuring a trio of characters walking forward in a hallway, overlaid with high-impact, bright yellow sans-serif typography that dominates the central vertical axis.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between yellow type and dark clothing
Symmetrical character arrangement framing the central figure
Grainy texture unifying photography and graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures at mid-ground, scaled to fill the vertical frame from waist up, with the central figure slightly forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, central title text spanning the middle third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top metadata text, drops to the central title, then follows the characters' forward motion toward the bottom credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and purples in the clothing and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant yellow for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and leopard print details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text against a desaturated, low-key photographic background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and tracking to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the main title.
Provides the clean, condensed, and modern-retro look for the metadata.
Offers the necessary variety in condensed weights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic, grainy photo of three people (two men, one woman) in 1980s athletic and casual wear walking down a dimly lit hallway. The central man wears a dark robe with leopard print trim. Use a low-angle shot and desaturated colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bright yellow, extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in the center. Stack the main title in three lines. Add metadata text at the very top and bottom with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the whole image?
Is the main title centered and overlapping the central figure?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent film grain across text and image.
Ensure the yellow text is the brightest element in the frame.
Verify the condensed nature of the typeface.
Confirm the low-angle perspective of the photography.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a desaturated cinematic character shot + apply heavy film grain + overlay extra-condensed bold yellow uppercase type centered vertically.
